pipeline_timer_scope: after engine initialization, before lookup/trip reading through successful Parquet write; excludes feature profiling and output comparison

pipeline_resources.scope: whole VM; includes OS, monitoring and other processes
pipeline_resources.ram_definition: MemTotal minus MemAvailable; differs from top used-memory accounting
pipeline_resources.cpu_definition: aggregate across all virtual CPUs, 0-100%; idle and iowait excluded
pipeline_resources.limitation: sampled maxima for this subset and phase, not true instantaneous or full-dataset peaks

feature_stage.scope: distance, duration and speed columns materialized from cached joined input; includes scheduling, conversion and cache population; excludes joins and export; not pure function-body CPU time
feature_stage.repetitions: one warmup and three timed trials in one application; not independent full-pipeline replications
feature_stage.execution_sink: Spark persist(MEMORY_AND_DISK) and count; sum consumes cached speed after timing
